name: Price Error Agent
tagline: Spots pricing mistakes at Australian retailers and on flights out of Australia
description: Some listings go up with a digit missing or the tax left off, and vanish within hours. This one watches bargain boards and cheap-fare feeds, among them Beat That Flight, Secret Flying and OzBargain, for exactly those slips at big Australian shops and on flights out of the country, and pings you when a real one shows.
author: yoda_FDE
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
